body:
Patch release rolling up the splash + templates-page work from 2026-05-01 → 2026-05-03.

## Splash screens (both apps)

* New animated SVG wordmarks split into GHOST + (PIPER | FRIGHTENER) halves.
* Timeline: GHOST `rippleIn` (0.2s) → 200ms beat → second-word slide (PIPER `slideLeft`, FRIGHTENER `slideUp`) → 600ms hold → joint glitch-up exit at 2.8s where sharp copies fade and blurred copies drift up with skew waves.
* Per-app preload hints, splash min-display extended to 5000ms so the exit completes.
* Sibling-app SVGs warmed post-load so app-switch hops have them already cached.

## Templates page

* Three stacked top cards (Summary / Search / Filter) collapsed into one merged panel with a vertical divider — filters one-axis-per-row on the left; stats, search, **Column key** + Clear all on the right.
* Filter counter and page-size selector moved into the existing pagination strip below the table.
* Removed the "Field present" pill row. Each completeness column header is now a 3-state filter-cycle: click cycles **all** (grey) → **present** (green) → **not present** (red).
* Page is now a viewport-pinned flex column (no page-level scroll); table card flexes to fill remaining height — replaces the magic `100vh - 18rem` budget.
* `gp_description` column dropped from the visible grid (constant + check function preserved for programmatic callers).

## Fixes

* **Compliance References** lookup: read all known key variants (`compliance_references` / `extra_compliance_reference` / camelCase) so real GW data is recognised. Live cache now shows 141/463 templates populated instead of 0/463.
* **Validator-pending fields** (CVSS Vector, Impact, References, Compliance References) fall back to a presence check when no validator rule is configured, instead of always rendering grey question-mark. Real green/red surfaces immediately; a configured + enabled validator still overrides with stricter rules.

## Tests

940 passed, 2 skipped. Updated splash-asset preload contract, field-order count (8 not 9), validator-pending status expectations, table colspan.
